stub.label: Stub only
stub.description: Only create an article stub without the article body. This is useful for discussing articles without storing full text that is not yet being used. Not available for YouTube videos.

article.label: Full text
article.description: Import the full article, or for a YouTube URL the video's transcript, without creating a lens.

article-and-lens.label: Full text + lens
article-and-lens.description: Import the full article (or for a YouTube URL the video's transcript) and create a lens for it.
